en: Yes, students without a physical ID are usually allowed during the first month of the school year, especially first-year students who do not have their ID yet.
You can present your validated COR to the entrance guard so they can verify that you are an officially enrolled first-year student.
Make sure it is a validated COR, and explain clearly why you do not have your student ID yet.
If you lost your student ID, ask the guard about the entry process and explain why your ID is missing. Make sure to bring your validated COR.
If you only forgot your student ID, it is better to go back and bring it. If that is not possible, ask the guard if there is another way to enter temporarily.
Always bring your student ID when entering campus. If you do not have one yet, process your student ID at the University Press.
ceb: Oo, kasagaran allowed ang students nga wala pay physical ID sulod sa unang bulan sa school year, labi na ang first-year students nga wala pa nakakuha sa ilang ID.
Pwede nimo ipakita ang imong validated COR sa entrance guard aron ma-verify nila nga officially enrolled first-year student ka.
Siguroa nga validated COR kini, ug taronga og explain nganong wala pa kay student ID.
Kung nawala imong student ID, pangutana sa guard bahin sa entry process ug isulti nganong nawala imong ID. Siguroa nga dala nimo ang imong validated COR.
Kung nabilin ra nimo imong student ID, mas maayo nga balikan nimo ug dad-on. Kung dili na mahimo, pangutana sa guard kung naa bay temporary way nga makasulod.
Kanunay dad-a imong student ID kung mosulod sa campus. Kung wala pa kay ID, iprocess imong student ID sa University Press.

en: To validate your student ID, go to OVPCASSS and ask a staff member in that office for ID validation assistance.
Bring your validated COR, and remove your ID from its ID case before presenting it for validation.
ID validation is only done during the official ID validation period. For the specific schedule, visit the OVPCASSS official page: https://www.facebook.com/buksuOSS
Usually, ID validation happens from August to September for the first semester and from January to February for the second semester.

Students who did not comply during the official validation period may need to bring a letter of request explaining the reason for late validation. Ask OVPCASSS for the exact late-validation requirements.
ceb: Para ma-validate ang imong student ID, adto sa OVPCASSS ug pangutana sa staff sa maong opisina bahin sa ID validation.
Dad-a ang imong validated COR, ug kuhaa ang imong ID gikan sa ID case before nimo ipresent para sa validation.
Ang ID validation ginahimo lamang sulod sa opisyal nga ID validation period. Para sa specific schedule, bisitaha ang OVPCASSS official page: https://www.facebook.com/buksuOSS
Kasagaran, ang ID validation mahitabo from August to September para sa first semester ug January to February para sa second semester.

Ang mga estudyante nga wala naka-comply sulod sa official validation period mahimong kinahanglan magdala og letter of request nga nagpasabot sa rason sa late validation. Pangutana sa OVPCASSS para sa exact late-validation requirements.

en: Under BukSU guidelines, there is no rule prohibiting the use of an old or previously issued PE uniform.
If you do not have an official PE uniform yet, you are permitted to wear comfortable jogging pants that allow free movement, paired with a plain white upper/shirt.
If you already have your own or previous BukSU PE uniform, you may freely use it during your physical education classes.
ceb: Ubos sa mga lagda sa BukSU, walay gipahayag nga gidili ang paggamit sa daan o previous nga PE uniform.
Kung wala pa kay opisyal nga PE uniform, pwede ra ka magsul-ob og komportable nga jogging pants nga makalihok ka og gawasnon, inubanan sa plain puti nga t-shirt/upper.
Kung aduna na kay daan o kaugalingon nga BukSU PE uniform, pwede ra kaayo nimo kini gamiton sa imong Physical Education classes.
